summary: Added src/content/blog/beginner/intuition-line-palmistry.md, item 20 (the last Next 25 item) from docs/editorial-backlog.md, bounded entirely by the Director-verified Cheiro/Benham evidence in .ai-ops/evidence/PP-RELAY-050-cheiro-benham-intuition-line.md. The article names the feature only the Line of Intuition, describes its curved/near-semicircular course on the outer/percussion side between the Mount of Mercury and Mount of Luna with both authors' differing directional wording, distinguishes it from the Mercury/Health line by shape while noting Cheiro's through-or-alongside observation, keeps Cheiro's and Benham's historical associations attributed and separate, and states Palmistry Path's own policy (no psychic/clairvoyant validation, no accuracy claim for any impression) as a distinct, separately labeled statement. The FAQ declines the backlog's unverified 'Line of Clairvoyance' synonym without claiming no other source ever used it. Added one reciprocal link in m-line-palmistry.md's existing 'strong intuition' myth entry; declined a reciprocal link in minor-lines-overview.md and mount-of-luna.md because neither currently names this specific line and a natural link in either would require a broader rewrite or risk conflating the mount's general intuitive quality with the specific named feature. Corrected docs/editorial-backlog.md item 20's naming note, marked it published, and updated its Published-count marker (71 -> 72).
